SISO Adaptive Control v1.0.0

This is a software environment for demonstrating and evaluating machine learning methods for adaptive identification, prediction, and control of Single-Input Single-Output (SISO) dynamic systems using Higher-Order Neural Units (HONUs). The implemented methods are designed for efficient learning from limited data on resource-constrained computing platforms.
